# v1.7.0 — Custom providers get a name & multiple models

> **zread-pi 1.7.0**: the "Custom Provider" entry in the config UI used to be a single fixed slot
> (`custom`) with one model and no display name. It now behaves like any built-in provider: give it a
> name, pick the API protocol, and add as many models as you want from the same detail page.

## 🔧 What changed

| Area | Before (v1.6.0) | Now (v1.7.0) |
|---|---|---|
| Custom provider flow | Base URL → one model name → API Key (single slot id `custom`, no name) | **Name → Base URL → API protocol** (`t` cycles `openai-completions` / `openai-responses` / `anthropic-messages` / `google-generative-ai`), then lands on the standard provider detail page |
| Provider names | custom providers were displayed by their id | `llm.providers.<id>.name` (optional; falls back to the id), shown in the provider list and detail page |
| Models | exactly one model, typed inline during creation | as many as you want — the detail page's `a` / "Add custom model..." entry works for custom providers too (unchanged form: id / name / context window / max output / thinking / vision) |
| API Key | entered inline during creation | entered on the detail page, next to the model list (identical to built-in providers) |
| Editing | not possible from the UI | `e` on a custom provider's detail page opens `/config/provider/:id/edit` (name / Base URL / protocol; id, credentials and models are preserved) |
| Id generation | fixed `custom` | derived from the display name (slugified; CJK kept), de-duplicated against built-in and already-configured ids (`name`, `name-2`, `name-3`, …) — a builtin id is never shadowed |

- The API protocol was previously hard-defaulted to `openai-completions`; Anthropic- /
  Gemini-compatible endpoints can now be selected directly.
- Credentials still live in `~/.zread-pi/auth.json` (pi CredentialStore); renaming a provider does
  not touch them because the id never changes.
- Old configs with a `custom` entry keep working (name falls back to the id).

## 📦 Install

```bash
# Option 1: standalone binary (zip attached to this release, unzip and run)
#   zread-pi-v1.7.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# Option 2: from source
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <target-repo>
```

# v1.7.0 —— 自定义 Provider 支持命名与多模型

> **zread-pi 1.7.0**：配置界面里的「自定义 Provider」过去是一个固定槽位（id 恒为 `custom`）、
> 只能配一个模型、也没有显示名。现在它与内置 Provider 完全同等待遇：可以起名字、选协议，
> 并在同一个详情页里添加任意多个模型。

## 🔧 改动内容

| 位置 | 之前（v1.6.0） | 现在（v1.7.0） |
|---|---|---|
| 自定义 Provider 流程 | Base URL → 一个模型名 → API Key（固定 id `custom`，无名称） | **名称 → Base URL → API 协议**（`t` 循环切换 `openai-completions` / `openai-responses` / `anthropic-messages` / `google-generative-ai`），保存后进入标准 Provider 详情页 |
| Provider 名称 | 自定义 Provider 只能显示 id | 新增 `llm.providers.<id>.name`（可选，缺省回退 id），Provider 列表与详情页都会显示 |
| 模型 | 创建时内联填写，且只能一个 | 任意多个——详情页的 `a` /「添加自定义模型...」对自定义 Provider 同样可用（表单不变：id / 名称 / 上下文窗口 / 最大输出 / 思考 / 图片） |
| API Key | 创建时内联输入 | 在详情页与模型列表并列输入（与内置 Provider 完全一致） |
| 编辑 | 界面无法编辑 | 自定义 Provider 详情页按 `e` 进入 `/config/provider/:id/edit`（改名称 / Base URL / 协议；id、凭据与模型都保留） |
| id 生成 | 固定 `custom` | 由显示名派生（slug 化，中文保留原文），并与内置/已配置 id 去重（`name`、`name-2`、`name-3`…），不会覆盖内置 Provider |

- API 协议过去硬编码回退到 `openai-completions`；现在可以直接选 Anthropic / Gemini 兼容端点。
- 凭据仍在 `~/.zread-pi/auth.json`（pi CredentialStore）；改名不会动凭据，因为 id 永不改变。
- 旧配置里的 `custom` 条目继续可用（名称回退到 id）。

## 📦 安装

```bash
# 方式一：standalone 二进制（本 Release 附带的 zip，解压即用）
#   zread-pi-v1.7.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# 方式二：从源码运行
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <目标仓库>
```
